2 These Writ Petitions have been filed against the various impugned orders and notices.

On a perusal of the impugned orders, it is made clear that there is an appeal remedy as against the impugned orders under Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal. Therefore, this Court cannot entertain these Writ Petitions under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, when there is appeal provisions, as contemplated in the statute as against the orders impugned in these Writ Petitions. 
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis W.P.No.17565 of 2022 etc. batch 3 . Accordingly, these Writ Petitions are dismissed, with liberty to the petitioner to challenge the orders impugned in these Writ Petitions before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal, within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. The operation of the impugned orders is stayed till the disposal of the appeal before the Food Safety Appellate Tribunal. If the petitioner fails to file an appeal before the said Appellate Tribunal within the above time stipulated by this Court,
the respondents are directed to proceed as against the petitioner. It is made clear that for the purpose of reckoning limitation for availing the aforesaid remedy, the period from the date of filing of these Writ Petitions, viz., 05.07.2022, 10.08.2022, 17.08.2022, 22.08.2022, 25.08.2022,
29.08.2022 and 06.09.2022 till the date on which the certified copy of this order is made ready by the Registry, shall be excluded. Consequently, the connected Miscellaneous Petitions are closed. No costs.
